items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: I was very — especially I mean the first concert, I mean with the Cannonball thing and George Shearing, — Kleinhans — you know I’m sitting way in the back

ctx.x: Do you recall, beyond the music, noticing how they operate on stage? Visual cues, just watching the bass player interact with the drummer, was any of that apparent to you? © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-

Oh yeah, yeah. I was very — especially I mean the first concert, I mean with the Cannonball thing and George Shearing, — Kleinhans — you know I’m sitting way in the back and you know I couldn’t really focus in on the interactions and that, but at the Town Casino I’m sitting right almost underneath him you know and I could see. And then of course everybody had an eye on Miles ‘cause he had a reputation for doing different stuff, turning his back or leaving the stage, you know and that kind of stuff you know. And…
He wasn’t that much older than you at the time, was he?
